title: Readiness probe points at a path that returns 404

root_cause.summary: The readiness probe requests /ready-wrong, which returns 404, so pods are Running but never Ready and the Service has no endpoints.

required_evidence: Pods are Running with zero restarts but not Ready
Events show Readiness probe failed with HTTP status 404
Service catalog has no ready endpoints
red_herrings: Container logs look healthy; the application itself is fine
The liveness probe passes, so the container is not restarting
No resource pressure or scheduling problems
fix: Change the readiness probe path to a valid endpoint such as /readyz.
